summary: Enhance your skills with our Documents & Records Management Training Course. Learn best practices to streamline your workflow and improve efficiency.
lede: Records management courses help professionals responsible for records, document control, or compliance organize information across paper and digital systems. They practice building inventories and file plans, classifying and indexing records, setting retention and disposition controls, and managing access, audit trails, and legal holds; digital governance and reporting are also introduced.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who handle records, oversee document control, or support compliance across paper and digital environments.
prerequisites: You should bring familiarity with your organization’s filing practices, retention requirements, and approval workflow. A laptop is recommended for template-based exercises, and sample policies, file plans, retention tables, or repository screenshots will help you apply the tools to your own context.
